name: UPI / BHIM — NPCI Dispute Redressal & DigiSaathi

blocking_methods.label: digisaathi
blocking_methods.instructions: Call DigiSaathi (NPCI's 24x7 digital-payments helpline) for guidance on freezing UPI access and raising disputes: 1800-891-3333.

blocking_methods.label: npci-dispute
blocking_methods.instructions: Raise a UPI transaction dispute with the 12-digit transaction reference at the PSP/TPAP app first; escalate PSP bank > account bank > NPCI via https://www.npci.org.in/what-we-do/upi/dispute-redressal-mechanism. For fraud, also call 1930 immediately — the NPCI complaint route recovers money, it does not freeze in-flight transactions.

blocking_methods.label: 1930-cross-ref
blocking_methods.instructions: For unauthorized UPI transactions, call 1930 within the golden hour (see the cybercrime-1930 entry) — UPI fraud freeze flows through the same MHA-bank fraud-monitoring path.

blocking_methods.label: bhim-support
blocking_methods.instructions: BHIM app-specific issues: bhim.support@npci.org.in (NPCI BHIM Services Limited). Complaints can also be filed with screenshots via https://www.bhimupi.org.in/get-in-touch.
